doc.summary: Data model types for the readmenator knowledge graph.
doc.description:
Defines the core entity types -- Symbol, Node, Edge -- plus a
utility function for pluralising symbol kind labels and a helper
for constructing community analysis results. Every parser, scanner,
renderer, and query engine depends on these definitions.

doc.summary: A single code symbol extracted from a source file.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier of the symbol (class name, function name, etc.).

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Semantic type (class, function, struct, enum, ...).

attributes.name: line
attributes.description: One-based line number where the symbol is defined.

attributes.name: doc
attributes.description: Optional docstring or comment extracted from the source.

attributes.name: signature
attributes.description: Optional method or function signature snippet.

doc.summary: A file node in the knowledge graph, containing its symbols.

attributes.name: node_id
attributes.description: Relative path of the file used as a unique identifier.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Base file name for display purposes.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Type of node (typically "module").

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Programming language derived from the file extension.

attributes.name: doc
attributes.description: Optional file-level documentation string.

attributes.name: symbols
attributes.description: List of Symbol instances defined in this file.

doc.summary: A directed relationship between two nodes in the knowledge graph.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Node ID of the source (dependent) file.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Node ID of the target (dependency) file or module.

attributes.name: relation
attributes.description: Semantic relation label (e.g. "imports", "resolved_imports").

attributes.name: confidence
attributes.description: Confidence tier ("EXTRACTED" for structural, "INFERRED" for heuristic).

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Optional typed edge kind for ranking-aware computations.

doc.summary: A security-relevant pattern detected in a source file.

attributes.name: file_path
attributes.description: Relative path of the file containing the finding.

attributes.name: line
attributes.description: One-based line number where the pattern was found.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Severity level (critical, high, medium, low, info).

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the detection rule (e.g. "PY001").

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Human-readable explanation of the issue.

attributes.name: snippet
attributes.description: The offending source code line.

attributes.name: cwe
attributes.description: CWE identifier string (e.g. "CWE-78").

attributes.name: mitre_attack
attributes.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID (e.g. "T1059.001").

name: pluralize_symbol_kind
signature: def pluralize_symbol_kind(kind: str, plural_map: Dict[str, str]) -> str

doc.summary: Return the plural form of *kind* according to *plural_map*.
doc.description:
Falls back to appending ``"s"`` when the kind is not found.
This prevents obvious misspellings like ``"Classs"``.

doc.summary: Result of community detection on the import graph.

attributes.name: community_id
attributes.description: Integer identifier of the community.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Human-readable name for the community.

attributes.name: file_ids
attributes.description: Set of node IDs belonging to this community.

attributes.name: cohesion
attributes.description: Cohesion score (internal edges / total edges involving community).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Number of files in the community.

doc.summary: Complete graph analysis output.

attributes.name: god_nodes
attributes.description: List of (node_id, score) for most central nodes.

attributes.name: communities
attributes.description: List of CommunityResult instances.

attributes.name: surprising_connections
attributes.description: List of (source_node, target_node, hops, bridging_communities).

attributes.name: suggested_questions
attributes.description: List of plain-language exploration questions.

attributes.name: node_count
attributes.description: Total nodes in the graph.

attributes.name: edge_count
attributes.description: Total edges in the graph.

doc.summary: A taint propagation path from source to sink through the import graph.

attributes.name: source_file
attributes.description: The file that introduces the dangerous import.

attributes.name: sink_file
attributes.description: The file that transitively receives the taint.

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: List of file node IDs forming the propagation chain.

attributes.name: hops
attributes.description: Number of hops in the propagation path.

attributes.name: dangerous_import
attributes.description: The specific dangerous module or function imported.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Inferred severity of the taint path.

doc.summary: Complete taint propagation analysis output.

attributes.name: paths
attributes.description: List of TaintPath instances discovered.

attributes.name: source_count
attributes.description: Number of unique taint source files.

attributes.name: sink_count
attributes.description: Number of unique taint sink files.

doc.summary: A cycle detected in the resolved import graph.

attributes.name: cycle
attributes.description: List of file node IDs forming the cycle.

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: Number of files in the cycle.

doc.summary: Change impact analysis for a single file.

attributes.name: file_id
attributes.description: The file that would be changed.

attributes.name: direct_dependents
attributes.description: Files that directly import this file.

attributes.name: transitive_dependents
attributes.description: Files that transitively depend on this file.

attributes.name: total_impact
attributes.description: Total number of affected files (direct + transitive).

doc.summary: A hotspot file combining complexity and centrality metrics.

attributes.name: file_id
attributes.description: The file node ID.

attributes.name: complexity_score
attributes.description: Normalised symbol count score (0-1).

attributes.name: centrality_score
attributes.description: Normalised god node score (0-1).

attributes.name: combined_score
attributes.description: Weighted combination of complexity and centrality.

attributes.name: symbol_count
attributes.description: Raw symbol count.

attributes.name: connection_count
attributes.description: Raw connection count.

doc.summary: A suggested linting/security rule derived from code patterns.

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.description: Suggested rule identifier (e.g. "RM001").

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Suggested severity (info, warning, error).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the pattern.

attributes.name: pattern
attributes.description: The detected pattern or code snippet.

attributes.name: file_examples
attributes.description: Example file paths where the pattern was found.

attributes.name: match_count
attributes.description: Number of times the pattern was matched.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Target language for the rule.

attributes.name: semgrep_yaml
attributes.description: Optional Semgrep rule YAML string.

doc.summary: A detected architectural layer violation.

attributes.name: source_file
attributes.description: The file causing the violation.

attributes.name: source_layer
attributes.description: The layer of the source file.

attributes.name: target_file
attributes.description: The file being imported.

attributes.name: target_layer
attributes.description: The layer of the target file.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Description of the violation.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Severity (strict, warn, info).

doc.summary: Extended analysis result combining all new analysis modules.

attributes.name: taint
attributes.description: Optional taint analysis result.

attributes.name: cycles
attributes.description: List of dependency cycles.

attributes.name: change_impacts
attributes.description: List of change impact results for key files.

attributes.name: hotspots
attributes.description: List of hotspot results.

attributes.name: suggested_rules
attributes.description: List of suggested linting rules.

attributes.name: layer_violations
attributes.description: List of layer violations.

attributes.name: dataflow_issues
attributes.description: List of procedural dataflow findings.

attributes.name: concept_graph
attributes.description: Optional semantic noun/verb layer.

doc.summary: A procedural intra-function dataflow finding.

attributes.name: file_path
attributes.description: Relative path of the file containing the issue.

attributes.name: function
attributes.description: Name of the enclosing function.

attributes.name: line
attributes.description: One-based line number of the suspicious operation.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Issue kind (UNINIT_USE, DEAD_STORE, UNCHECKED_ALLOC).

attributes.name: variable
attributes.description: Name of the involved local variable.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Human-readable explanation of the suspicion.

attributes.name: confidence
attributes.description: Confidence tier (always INFERRED for heuristics).

doc.summary: A violation detected by the architecture linter.

attributes.name: file_path
attributes.description: Relative path of the file containing the violation.

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the linter rule (e.g. "ARC001").

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Severity level (error, warning, info).

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the violation.

doc.summary: A dead code symbol identified by the stripper.

attributes.name: file_path
attributes.description: Relative path of the file containing the symbol.

attributes.name: symbol_name
attributes.description: Name of the dead symbol.

attributes.name: symbol_type
attributes.description: Type of symbol (function, class, method, etc.).

attributes.name: recommendation
attributes.description: Recommended action (MOVE_TO_TRASH, REVIEW, KEEP).

doc.summary: A single refactoring action within a plan.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Type of action (EXTRACT_CLASS, EXTRACT_FUNCTION, MOVE_SYMBOL).

attributes.name: source_file
attributes.description: The file to refactor.

attributes.name: start_line
attributes.description: Start line of the code range to extract.

attributes.name: end_line
attributes.description: End line of the code range to extract.

attributes.name: target_file
attributes.description: The new file to create (for EXTRACT actions).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the action.

doc.summary: A complete refactoring plan for a monolithic file.

attributes.name: file_path
attributes.description: The file to refactor.

attributes.name: actions
attributes.description: List of refactoring actions to perform.

attributes.name: estimated_impact
attributes.description: Number of files affected by the refactoring.

attributes.name: current_lines
attributes.description: Current line count of the file.

doc.summary: A semantic noun node in the concept graph.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Normalised noun label (lowercase token).

attributes.name: file_ids
attributes.description: Set of file node IDs where the noun appears.

attributes.name: mention_count
attributes.description: Total atomic mentions across paths and symbols.

attributes.name: confidence
attributes.description: Confidence tier (always EXTRACTED for parsed tokens).

doc.summary: A verb edge between two concept noun nodes.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Source concept name.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Target concept name.

attributes.name: verb
attributes.description: Verb label (consumes, invokes, extends, depends_on, bridges).

attributes.name: file_evidence
attributes.description: Sorted file pairs proving the relation.

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: Normalised strength in [0, 1].

attributes.name: confidence
attributes.description: Confidence tier (always INFERRED for heuristics).

doc.summary: Deterministic semantic layer over the structural graph.

attributes.name: concepts
attributes.description: Ordered concept noun nodes (ranked by file coverage).

attributes.name: relations
attributes.description: Ordered verb edges between concepts.

attributes.name: dialectic_questions
attributes.description: Deterministic thesis/antithesis prompts.
